review_candidates.description: Location New York; Dublin; Lisbon; London; Warsaw Employment Type Full time Location Type Remote Department Product OverviewApplication Meet Siena Siena is the The Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns. It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on. The team We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do. We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock. If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading. What we’re looking for You're a builder who thrives at the frontier of AI agents, customer experience, and ecommerce. We Welcome Multiple Paths: The operator who wants to build — you've been a solutions engineer, implementation manager, technical account manager, or worked in customer success at technical startups. You've implemented complex systems, managed enterprise rollouts, architected solutions. You understand both the customer pain and the product. You've seen where systems break in production. Now you want to shape the future of CX with your operator experience. The technical PM — you've been shipping product at technical B2B companies—ideally in CX, helpdesk, ecommerce, marketing tools, or AI automation. You understand how software gets built and adopted. You thrive working cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams. The consumer-minded builder — you understand what makes products feel good to use. You think about user behavior, ecommerce, purchase patterns, building premium experiences. Maybe you've worked on consumer products, growth teams, or analytics-heavy roles. You bring a user-first lens to enterprise software. What matters across all paths: you understand complex systems, you ship fast, you have high standards, and you want to build AI agents that interact with millions of consumers. Work with us for a trial week on a real project. Ship something meaningful while experiencing our culture firsthand. We'll see how you work, you'll meet the team, and we'll both figure out if Siena feels right for you. Why Siena? Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox. Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast. A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in. A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one. Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build. review_candidates.title: Member of Technical Staff - Robotics Lab (Remote)
review_candidates.description: Role: Member of Technical Staff - Robotics Lab (Remote) Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere) Job Type: Full-Time Payout: $400K - $1500K/yr Role Overview: We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Member of Technical Staff (Robotics Lab) to work on a full-time basis. The role involves designing, developing, and deploying robotics systems with a focus on scalable autonomy and real-time control. Candidates will collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate hardware and software solutions for next-generation robotic platforms. Key Responsibilities: • Design and implement control algorithms for robotic systems, including kinematics, dynamics, and path planning. • Develop and maintain software for robot perception, localization, and mapping using sensor fusion techniques. • Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate sensors, actuators, and embedded systems into functional robotic prototypes. • Optimize robotic performance for efficiency, reliability, and safety in dynamic environments. • Document technical specifications, test results, and deployment procedures for internal and external stakeholders. Required Skills & Qualifications: • Proficiency in robotics frameworks such as ROS, ROS 2, or similar platforms. • Strong programming skills in C++, Python, or other relevant languages for robotics applications. • Experience with real-time control systems, embedded software, and hardware-in-the-loop testing. • Knowledge of computer vision, SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping), or sensor fusion techniques. • Familiarity with simulation tools like Gazebo, CoppeliaSim, or NVIDIA Isaac Sim is required. • Experience with robotic operating systems, middleware, and communication protocols (e.g., CAN, Ethernet, UDP). • Ability to design and analyze algorithms for motion planning, obstacle avoidance, and task execution. • Experience with version control systems such as Git and collaborative software development workflows. • Understanding of machine learning techniques for robotics, including reinforcement learning or imitation learning. • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex robotic systems. More About the Opportunity: This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Information Services industry, contributing to the development of autonomous robotic systems for industrial and commercial applications. The position involves high-impact work with cutting-edge technology and the chance to shape the future of robotics in a fast-evolving field. Equal Opportunity Employer: We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. Apply Now!

review_candidates.title: HR Technology & Analytics Manager
review_candidates.description: At d-Matrix , we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of respect and collaboration. We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our team is inclusive , and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution. Ready to come find your playground? Together , we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. Role Overview d-Matrix is building the next generation of AI inference technology, and scaling that ambition requires an equally forward-looking approach to how we build and run our People function. We're looking for an HR Technology & Analytics Manager to own the technology, data, and workflow foundation across People Operations, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partnership, payroll, benefits, performance, and compensation. This is a hands-on role for someone who pairs deep HR technology expertise with strong analytical capability and a genuine interest in how automation and AI can improve how People teams work. You'll serve as the primary owner of HR technology strategy and administration, people data governance, and process optimization — partnering closely with the CHRO, People Operations, HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and IT to build reliable systems and a trusted source of People data. You'll also play a key role in People-related M&A diligence and integration. What You Will Do Own and optimize the HR technology ecosystem — HRIS, talent acquisition, performance/talent management, benefits, retirement, and payroll-related integrations — including system configuration, data architecture, and permissions. Assess the current HR technology environment, build a forward-looking roadmap, and lead requirements gathering, RFPs, vendor evaluation, and implementation when new systems are needed. Map and redesign end-to-end People processes (recruiting-to-hire, onboarding, promotions, compensation changes, transfers, leaves, offboarding) to improve accuracy, speed, and the employee/manager experience. Identify manual or error-prone processes and implement automation and practical AI applications across People operations, reporting, and workflows. Establish data governance, controls, and recurring audit practices, translating data into insights and dashboards that support headcount, workforce, and organizational health decisions. Own data standards and be hands-on in the systems — entering, correcting, and reconciling data during cleanup, implementation, or high-priority issue resolution. Partner with People Operations and payroll providers to ensure accurate data flow into U.S. and international payroll, benefits, and retirement processes. Lead HR technology, data, and systems integration workstreams for M&A, including assessing acquired-company systems and building repeatable integration processes. What You Will Bring 8+ years of progressive experience in HR technology, HRIS, People Operations, or People Analytics, with significant hands-on ownership of HR technology and employee data. Demonstrated experience owning multiple HR technology platforms and the integrations/data flows between them. Deep experience administering a major HRIS platform. Strong People Analytics capability, with the ability to move from raw data to meaningful business insights. Advanced Excel skills and strong overall data fluency. Experience designing and improving HR workflows, approval processes, and automation. Demonstrated ability to identify, investigate, and resolve complex data and systems issues. Strong project management, communication, and cross-functional partnership skills. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience with ADP Workforce Now. Experience supporting People-related M&A diligence, data migration, or integration. Understanding of U.S. and international/global payroll, benefits, and retirement-plan data flows. Experience in a high-growth, global technology environment. Demonstrated experience applying AI and emerging technologies to improve HR processes and productivity. Equal Opportunity Employment Policy d-Matrix is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day. d-Matrix does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

review_candidates.title: Driver
review_candidates.description: Company Description Self-employed driving roles offer individuals the opportunity to manage their own schedules and operate independently while providing reliable transportation services. As a self-employed driver in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, you may work with logistics companies, local businesses, or private clients to transport goods or passengers. This arrangement allows for flexibility in choosing assignments while maintaining professional standards of safety and service. The focus is on dependable, punctual, and efficient driving that meets client expectations and complies with local regulations. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Driver role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The Driver will be responsible for operating trucks or other assigned vehicles safely, transporting goods between specified locations, and following all traffic and safety regulations. Daily tasks include conducting pre- and post-trip vehicle inspections, loading and unloading cargo when required, maintaining accurate delivery records, and communicating with clients or dispatch to confirm schedules and delivery details. The Driver will also ensure the vehicle is kept clean, well-maintained, and compliant with relevant licensing and registration requirements, while providing courteous and professional service to all customers and partners. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Truck Driving skills and be able to operate trucks safely and efficiently. Candidates should possess a valid CDL Class A or equivalent heavy vehicle license appropriate for Dubai and regional regulations. Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to coordinate with clients, dispatchers, and colleagues. Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to provide polite, respectful, and professional interactions with all customers. Candidates should possess familiarity with truck maintenance basics and safe handling of cargo. Clean driving record and strong knowledge of local traffic laws and routes in Dubai and surrounding areas. Ability to work full time, manage schedules reliably, and handle physically demanding tasks such as loading and unloading. Prior experience in commercial or logistics driving is beneficial; basic English or Arabic language skills are an advantage.
